description:
Honor "always use the latest model from every provider" as a default-intent sentinel — WITHOUT the model-currency footguns that caused the 1.0.0 saga (L-008).

- Support `model: 'latest'` (and treat unset model as latest) resolved PER BACKEND:
  - gemini (agy): query `agy models`, pick the newest via a version-sort heuristic, with a SAFE FALLBACK to a known-good Flash id if parsing fails or returns nothing.
  - codex: 'latest' = the latest model the SDK-PINNED binary supports — NOT the newest announced model (chasing that is exactly the L-008 / bundled-binary trap). Derive from / bound by the SDK pin.
- Keep explicit pins fully working (recommend-not-enforce, L-006). Surface the RESOLVED model in the result/logs so it's transparent which model actually ran.
- This advances the existing Model Currency phase goal across both providers (cross-link).

Acceptance: model:'latest' resolves to a current Flash for gemini and an SDK-supported id for codex; brittle `agy models` parsing degrades to a safe fallback; an explicit model always wins over 'latest'.
title: model: "latest" resolver across providers
